clusters.agenda_text: A second earthquake strikes the province of Granada, in Spain. Damage and injures are reported in Granada and the surrounding area, while the Alhambra is evacuated
clusters.headline: Granada experiences earthquake with evacuations and injuries reported

members.title: Granada torna a tremare, nuova scossa di terremoto: evacuazioni, danni e feriti

clusters.summary: A new earthquake struck Granada, causing evacuations, damage to buildings, and injuries to residents. The seismic event prompted emergency response efforts in the affected area.

clusters.agenda_text: A Spanish F/A-18 Hornet jet shoots down a Russian drone in Romanian airspace. The drone was downed near Galați after entering from Moldova
clusters.headline: Spanish F/A-18 Hornet shoots down Russian drone in Romanian airspace
clusters.summary: A Spanish F/A-18 Hornet jet shot down a Russian drone in Romanian airspace near Galați after the drone entered from Moldova.

clusters.agenda_text: Three people, including a teenager, are killed and two others are injured in a shooting in Isla Cristina, Andalusia, Spain. Police investigate the attack as a possible dispute between rival drug-trafficking groups and search for the gunman
clusters.headline: Three people killed and two wounded in shooting in Isla Cristina, Spain
clusters.summary: A shooting in Isla Cristina, Andalusia, Spain resulted in the deaths of three people, including a teenager, and injuries to two others. Police are investigating the attack as a possible dispute between rival drug-trafficking groups and are searching for the gunman.

clusters.agenda_text: Police in Morocco arrest 111 migrants who attempted to enter Spain's autonomous community Ceuta, amidst tightened security on both sides of the border with Spain
clusters.headline: Morocco police arrest 111 migrants attempting to enter Spanish enclave Ceuta
clusters.summary: Police in Morocco have arrested 111 migrants who attempted to enter Spain's autonomous community of Ceuta. The arrests occurred amid heightened security measures on both sides of the border between Morocco and Spain.

clusters.agenda_text: A earthquake strikes the province of Granada in Spain, with damage reported in Granada and the surrounding area, and being felt in Madrid
clusters.headline: Earthquake strikes Granada province in Spain
clusters.summary: An earthquake has struck the province of Granada in Spain, causing damage in Granada and the surrounding area. The tremor was felt as far away as Madrid.
